Highly recommended this Place! I had severe tooth pain while on holiday and was seen immediately. The dentists were very friendly and highly competent. An infected tooth root was quickly diagnosed, an X-ray taken, and everything explained to me in excellent English.
The next day, a specialist performed a root canal treatment and filling. Very professional and efficient – my holiday was saved. Thank you to the entire team, I would definitely recommend this clinic!

No exaggeration this is the best dental clinic in Chiang Mai, While the pricing is very affordable the quality of service is still that of the highest standards. I have visited dentists from Australia to Germany and I can honestly say that Ben that practices at this clinic has knowledge, attentiveness and attention to detail second to none. Highly recommend and I will be stopping in for a clean and a check up everytime I am in Chiang Mai. This is a terrific establishment that deserves a sixth or even seventh star for it's wonderful staff.

I've been here twice now. The service is excellent. I got my teeth cleaned and was covered by my social security.
The counter staff were very helpful and gave me good advice. They were lovely.
The first time I had my teeth cleaned, I met a lovely female doctor. She was quick and thorough. It wasn't painful at all. She gave me great advice too. 😻🫰
